confirmed_local_grant_failure.finding: The original 500 ms primitive contract remains unchanged. This run again reached its first failed tick at request age 501 ms. This is not successful R19 acceleration and not proof of why no eligible fresh Grant arrived.

bound_source_control_flow: Bridge line 2365 records the failed adapter tick before the fallback decision.
Lines 2367-2374 permit continued execution after a non-NoAction tick only when r19_service_pre_negotiation_fallback(now_ms) returns true; otherwise the permanent global runtime latch is set.

Lines 6269-6399 require the exact original request/t0/epoch, both immutable AwaitFreshGrant -> FailClosed / GrantDeadlineExceeded results, no fresh/staged Grant, no R19 session/VCBN prefix/freeze/proof/writer activity, and an empty ordinary ingress FIFO.
The helper requires one new NativeStream proxy lease for byte-identical held #21, ordinary queue admission, and a second epoch/host/endpoint check before deselecting acceleration.
The adapter is not reset or rearmed. Success leaves its original failed snapshot intact, marks acceleration consumed, deselects the R19 route, and retains ordinary TDD routing.

The global stop sets bridge_ready=false and runtime_fail_closed=true at lines 2641-2650; ordinary product routing has repeated guards against this state. No production path clears that permanent global stop.

observed_continuation.alive_status_packing: The sixth byte high bit is adapter_fail_closed, not the global runtime_fail_closed flag. Its low seven bits are standard TDD state. Code: r19_runtime_fail_diagnostic.hpp lines 570-572 and 615-619; bridge snapshot lines 2610-2637.

fallback_assessment.inference: A refused fallback would have latched the global stop at 13271 ms and could not produce newly forwarded product traffic for the following tens of seconds. Bound source plus the frozen failed adapter, later CRC-valid product responses/Heartbeat, normal UART activity, and later L-state diagnostics strongly identify successful one-shot fallback. This is a code-path inference, not an independently acquired value of fallback_count=1 or direct proof of the exact physical UART request payload/count.
not_claimed: No acquired fallback RAM counter, held frame bytes, selected-route boolean or consumed boolean is invented.
No acquired exact #21 E220 UART payload or physical on-air request count is available.
No VCBN/VCRC session success or R19 high-speed completion is claimed.
The standard-path proxy may have its own ordinary transaction behavior; one PC #21 write does not prove a single physical UART transaction.

product_observations.method: Independent saved Ground raw-byte replay: scan complete MAVLink v2 frames, verify CRC using the canonical core/src/mavlink_frame.cpp CRC_EXTRA table, then map frame end offsets to saved capture block end ticks. No live reads or serial calls.

heartbeat.limitation: These are PC user-space completed-read intervals, not physical emission intervals or proof that all intended Heartbeats were delivered. Same-run full acceptance still fails the parameter target.

parameter_request.finding: The safe slow-path return permitted valid responses, but 4/932 at 30 seconds is not the 932/932 target. No request-origin or 30-second ledger reset was used.

runtime_stage_and_distinct_diagnostic_US.finding: The 68-byte runtime-stage first_failure describes the diagnostic USB transport, not automatically the permanent bridge global runtime gate. Ground's diagnostic failure is approximately 40.044 seconds later on its own MCU clock than the 501-ms Grant failure. It cannot explain an earlier global stop that did not occur. Here the pending diagnostic ring is 59 bytes, not the historical 31-byte value.
runtime_stage_and_distinct_diagnostic_US.remaining_limitation: No guaranteed PC/MCU offset bounds were supplied; the Ground diagnostic failure cannot be conclusively ordered relative to PC reader stop/COM close. Diagnostic timeout is still an unresolved separate observation, not product all-error-zero acceptance.

vehicle_standard_progress.limitation: Vehicle values are its own MCU clock. Do not subtract from Ground or PC clock. Dropped journal entries prevent reconstructing every intervening cycle.

comparison_with_prior_c821_run.shared_local_condition: Both runs have an immutable first local GrantDeadlineExceeded at request age 501 ms without observed fresh/staged Grant.
comparison_with_prior_c821_run.changed_outcome: The prior c821 bridge promoted that adapter failure directly to the global bridge stop. The bound 896D bridge has a conservative pre-negotiation decline path, and this run continued product Heartbeats/normal parameter responses after the same local failure.

limitations_and_next_safe_scope: No more device operations are authorized by this analysis; the one-run trial has completed and accepted R18 restoration is recorded proven.
The one-shot fallback is supported for this successful clean-path case only. Refusal-case safety is covered by prior offline tests, not additional live trials in this report.
The actual physical reason a new Grant was unavailable inside 500 ms remains separate from the now-avoided full communication stop.

If a future requirement needs direct production proof of fallback count, exact byte ownership, or per-R18-request wire count, add explicitly versioned, bound diagnostic evidence in a separate authorized change; do not reinterpret reserved fields.
For real 932/932 within 30 seconds, the next work is a separately designed bounded fast-path admission/Grant agreement, not raising 500/2000/106 ms deadlines or hiding original request time.
This report does not authorize deployment or acceptance and does not claim all communication errors are zero.
